name: Juniper Moss
blurb: Runs the espresso stand at the ferry line, rides a café racer in a teal rain shell, and treats the road like a queue you cut.

meta.notes: Pacific Northwest local (region-pnw, playtest 1c). A weaver: quick, light, swerves across lanes, and kicks more than she punches. The weaver preset falls back to racer until the AI lane registers it. Signature line (agent draft, not yet maintainer-approved): "For here or to go? Oh, you're going."
